Draft reads your own bank and sales to size a line of credit that grows with your brand, so a big purchase order never has to wait for the retailer to pay. You draw what you need when stock is due, you see the fee before every draw, and you repay from the sales that stock makes, with nothing to pay on money you have not drawn and no equity given up at any point along the way.
